Original source unavailable: terminal cache miss 21ae3ca30ea09cd7c1aecb17.miss. Original values reproduced by Song were not used. Requested effect type is test statistic, but the target coefficient rows print regression coefficients and Newey–West standard errors, not coefficient-specific t/z tests; retained the printed coefficient without conversion. The table J-test and its p value test instrument restrictions, so neither is substituted for the target coefficient test. Reported success is the author’s overall narrative verdict; no separate verdict for this covariate is printed. Despite the overall confirming verdict, the author explicitly rejects the original substitution interpretation: p. 11 states “My replication results for both the 1970-1996 and 1996-2015 data confirm the independence of private and public goods consumption.” The same paragraph says the estimates are statistically insignificant at the 10 percent level. No exact coefficient p value is printed; p left null.
